description: Source file defining the terrain_type class and related functions for the Battle for Wesnoth project, handling terrain properties and mappings.

classes.name: terrain_type
classes.description: Represents a terrain type with properties such as symbol, name, id, and attributes like height adjustment, submerge level, and special flags.

methods.name: terrain_type()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing terrain type with default values.

methods.name: terrain_type(const config& cfg)
methods.description: Constructor initializing terrain type from a configuration object.

methods.name: symbol_image()
methods.description: Returns the symbol image associated with the terrain.

methods.name: name()
methods.description: Returns the name of the terrain.

methods.name: id()
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the terrain.

methods.name: letter()
methods.description: Returns the character representing the terrain.

methods.name: is_nonnull()
methods.description: Checks if the terrain has a non-null character.

methods.name: type()
methods.description: Returns the type string of the terrain.

methods.name: is_light()
methods.description: Checks if the terrain is light.

methods.name: is_alias()
methods.description: Checks if the terrain is an alias of another terrain.

methods.name: unit_height_adjust()
methods.description: Returns the height adjustment value for units on this terrain.

methods.name: unit_submerge()
methods.description: Returns the submerge level of the terrain.

methods.name: gives_healing()
methods.description: Checks if the terrain provides healing.

methods.name: is_village()
methods.description: Checks if the terrain is a village.

methods.name: is_castle()
methods.description: Checks if the terrain is a castle.

methods.name: is_keep()
methods.description: Checks if the terrain is a keep.

methods.name: create_terrain_maps()
methods.description: Creates mappings and lists of terrain types from configuration data.
